provenance.title: On the structure of wave functions in complex Chern–Simons theory

candidates.statement: For the theory to be unitary, $s$ must be real or purely imaginary, although we will not need this in our discussion.

Since the holomorphic block must reproduce the perturbative expansion of the wave function, it can be identified with the resummed WKB series in Eq. [\[WKB-conj\]](#WKB-conj){reference-type="eqref" reference="WKB-conj"}, that is,

However, we stress that, for such a solution to be consistent with the original choice of a classical branch labeled by $\alpha$, we must impose that, taking $P=Q=1$, we find $$\label{branch} \upsilon_0= \Pi \upsilon= P^{(\alpha)} \, ,$$ where $P^{(\alpha)}$ is the selected non-abelian solution of the classical $A$-polynomial at fixed $X$ after taking into account the corrections due to the exponential prefactor in Eq. [\[chi-matrix-2\]](#chi-matrix-2){reference-type="eqref" reference="chi-matrix-2"}.
